scripts.build-dev:darwin: pnpm run buildBinary-dev:darwin && pnpm run esbuild-dev && pnpm run build-types
scripts.build-dev:win32: pnpm run buildBinary-dev:win32 && pnpm run esbuild-dev && pnpm run build-types
scripts.buildBinary-dev:darwin: if [ -f 'bin/dev/Recorder' ]; then rm -rf bin/dev/Recorder; fi && xcodebuild -project src/swift/Recorder/Recorder.xcodeproj -scheme Recorder -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath src/swift/Recorder/build && cp src/swift/Recorder/build/Build/Products/Debug/Recorder bin/dev/Recorder && shasum -a 256 bin/dev/Recorder > dist/Recorder.sha256
scripts.buildBinary-prod:darwin: if [ -f 'bin/Recorder' ]; then rm -rf bin/Recorder; fi && xcodebuild -project src/swift/Recorder/Recorder.xcodeproj -scheme Recorder -configuration Release -derivedDataPath src/swift/Recorder/build && cp src/swift/Recorder/build/Build/Products/Release/Recorder bin/Recorder && shasum -a 256 bin/Recorder > dist/Recorder.sha256
scripts.build-prod:darwin: pnpm run buildBinary-prod:darwin && pnpm run esbuild-prod && pnpm run build-types
scripts.build-prod:win32: pnpm run buildBinary-prod:win32 && pnpm run esbuild-prod && pnpm run build-types
